NEXT, NOT STARTED: slice 3d, the wiring that replaces the 7 createKeychainKeyProvider sites in src/cli/main.ts, built to DEC-262 (a16) Q2 selection rules 1 to 5 (existing vault uses the backend holding its key by presence, never switches silently; more than one holder refuses as ambiguous naming both; at init macOS Keychain, Linux Secret Service if usable else TPM2 via /dev/tpmrm0 else platform_unsupported, no override flag; the backend in use is reported in status and doctor; nothing new written into the vault). 3d NEEDS ITS OWN DISPATCH FLOOR AND BRIEF FROM THE LEADER (fence: src/cli/main.ts and the new provider); do not start it before that. 3D BINDINGS AND CARRY LIST, all recorded on WCLI-21 (read there, verbatim rulings in the notes): (1) the provider MUST pass onWarning, with a test that fails if it drops the warning (a17). (2) doctor's human output AND its JSON show the untrusted-getcap reason and path at attention-state visibility, the test asserts tool_untrusted specifically and the word "untrusted" (a19, NN2). (3) route the provider's Tpm2Error (reason and detail, never the WardError) through tpm2StateFor. (4) re-run detection before a load so revoked access never reads as key_unloadable (key_unloadable is derived inside tpm2StateFor). (5) NN1: never render "0 saved sessions" when detection failed (no savedSessions key means zero OR no count taken). (6) render keyUnloadableSummary and keyUnloadableHint unchanged (a18). (7) N3 (a): the provider boundary translates tpm_key_not_sealed to vault_key_missing or teaches setup.ts and reporting.ts observeKey the TPM codes, and NEVER treats tpm_key_incomplete as missing; do not wire a tpm_* code into a live path before observeKey has its cases. (8) N3 (c): the presence check counts a lone .priv as the TPM holding a key. (9) N4: a non-Tpm2Error unseal failure loses flushFailure because spawnTool is unwrapped (#301 finding 10). (10) N7: NB4, a timeout can strand a saved session, is covered only by the doctor count. (11) N6: a concurrent unseal can show a self-clearing count of 1. (12) comment fix only: the comment above shebangParts in src/adapters/tpm2-tools.ts overstates the CRLF refusal. N2 is CLOSED (a17 item 1: no change). The named limitation (a20): tool_incompatible does not win by construction, a load the tools reject reads as key_unloadable. OTHER OPEN ITEMS: WCLI-157 PARTLY MET (needs a real-output measurement), WCLI-158 (a timed-out tool must let the CLI exit and kill the grandchild, owed to slice 3 at the latest, so surface it to the leader in the 3d brief), WCLI-159, WCLI-160 DO NOT START, WCLI-162, WCLI-82 and WCLI-92 (wait on the marketplace pin), WCLI-120 (waits on a real tag push; release is the operator's to cut). WORKTREES (DEC-208, LCLI-740 open: do NOT remove, deregister or prune any): every directory under .claude/worktrees/ (109 at the time of writing, listed by ls), notably ward-cli-review-323, 323b, 326, 326b, 326c, 331, 331b, 334 and 334b, and the older review-* and agent-* ones.
